attributes.long_name: squished-to-sensor column offset within the 2x2 Bayer block
attributes.comment: Column offset for mapping a squished pixel up to the cropped full- resolution grid: sensor_x = 2*sub_x + this[band]. The cropped-grid offset, i.e. the full-frame Bayer offset shifted by the crop-origin parity. In [0, 1].
